summary: Campaign 1 Kickoff: Core loop + thin UI (Nightlands co-op)
context: Launch Campaign 1 from the agreed stack: a 10-15 minute Nightlands co-op loop with a thin battlegrid/observer UI. Inputs must stay under existing guardrails and telemetry/ledger discipline.

directives.details: Adopt the Campaign 1 plan in planning/campaigns_and_lulls.md; confirm owners and milestone dates per workspace.
Build M1 core loop prototype with quick role select, 1-2 enemy archetypes, and one signature ability per role routed through emoji DSL/guardrails.
Ship minimal battlegrid/observer view + HUD tied to the emoji DSL; instrument Time-to-Fun, revive cadence, and 'one more run?' prompts.
Produce a playtestable slice (M3) with rollback toggles, cadence smoke (heartbeat -> offline_sync_exchange -> ops_readiness -> exchange_all), emitter smoke, and logs under logs/.
File ACK/report per workspace; log cadence runs and milestone completions to exchange/ledger/2025-11.md (or current) with evidence hooks.

success_criteria: Campaign 1 plan adopted with named owners and milestone dates
Core loop prototype playable with guardrails intact (emoji DSL routing enforced)
Thin UI/HUD shipped with telemetry for TTF, revive cadence, 'one more run?'
Playtestable slice delivered with rollback switch and cadence/emitter smoke logs archived
Ledger entries recorded for ACK + completion with evidence paths
